entries.title: PostReady: PR #780 — F1: platform-aware carousel limits (config, not hardcoded)
entries.description: Replaced hardcoded carousel slide limits with a platform-aware config system (F1), so per-platform maximums (LinkedIn, Instagram, etc.) can be managed centrally without code changes.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #781 — E4: Global carousel controls (non-destructive)
entries.description: Added non-destructive global style controls for the Carousel Creator (E4), letting users apply layout, color, and typography overrides across all slides without losing per-card customization.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #782 — Pro Prompt becomes carousel-aware
entries.description: Updated Pro Prompt to understand carousel context — prompting flows now generate structured, slide-aware copy instead of single-post prompts when in Carousel Creator mode.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #783 — Usage metering for carousels & Motion Posts (H3 #703, G4 #700)
entries.description: Pack credit usage is now tracked for Carousel Creator and Motion Post generations, completing epic milestones H3 and G4 — both content types are now metered against the user plan.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #784 — Smart image-engine routing: Seedream default, gpt-image-2 escalation
entries.description: Implemented smart image-engine routing: Seedream is the default model for standard image generation, with automatic escalation to gpt-image-2 for prompts requiring detailed text rendering or high-fidelity output.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #785 — Show post date on engagement popover
entries.description: Restored the missing post date on the hover engagement card: a subtle "Posted <date>" line (calendar icon) now appears under total engagements using the pack earliest publish date.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #787 — Review quote card renders in natural case, not ALL CAPS
entries.description: Fixed the testimonial review-to-post quote card rendering in ALL CAPS. Quote style now uses natural case so testimonials read as typed — more readable and authentic.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #786 — Carousel → Post Packs materialization + list badge
entries.description: A saved carousel now lands in Post Packs as a labeled carousel pack ready to act on (Part A: materialization + list badge). Publishing is Part B, coming next.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #788 — Review quote: Inter font + longer excerpt (140 chars)
entries.description: Follow-up to natural-case fix: swapped Anton for Inter (heavy) on the quote card for cleaner mixed-case readability, and raised the excerpt cap from 60 to 140 chars.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #789 — Carousel multi-image publishing per platform (gated off)
entries.description: Built carousel (multi-image) posting for all six platforms wired into the headless publish flow, gated off behind CAROUSEL_PUBLISH_ENABLED (default off) until Meta/LinkedIn production API approval lands. Non-carousel publishing is unchanged.
